figurative_meaning_en: To be considered as belonging to a lower stratum in society
similar_in_english: Born on the wrong side of the tracks
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে জাতে ওঠা লোক বলে সমাজে কেউ তাকে গুরুত্ব দেয় না।
তার পরিবার জাতে তোলা হিসেবে পরিচিত, তাই বিয়ের প্রস্তাব আসে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is considered low-born in society, so no one takes him seriously.
Her family is regarded as from a lower caste, so marriage proposals don't come.
history: This idiom originates from the historical caste system (varna) in ancient Indian society, which influenced Bengali social structures through Hinduism.
note: The idiom highlights persistent social inequalities rooted in traditional caste divisions.
